core_obligations: Choose a generic point x of an irreducible component of the support of the fibre F_s.
Use going-down for flat modules to find a specialization y leading to x inside the support of F with f(y) the generic point.
Reduce y to a generic point of an irreducible component of the support of the generic fibre.
Conclude the dimension bound from the associated-point specialization lemma.

proof_roadmap.step: Specialize from the generic fibre into the fibre support using going-down for flat modules.
Bound the component dimension via the associated-point lemma.

difficulty_reason: For a locally finite type morphism to an irreducible base and a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf flat over the base, the lemma bounds the dimension of the support of every fibre by the dimension of the support of the generic fibre. The proof is a written specialization argument: take a generic point x of an irreducible component of the fibre support, use going-down for flat modules to specialize from a point y over the generic point within the support, and bound the dimension of the closure of x via the associated-point specialization lemma. Retained author proof at lines 5264-5273.
